Scope: commits 9f2c633..8c6590a on branch v1 — src/ui/** (copy.ts, appReducer.ts, AppContext.tsx, App.tsx, components/{LoanForm,CurrencySelect,Header,ResultsPanel,ResultsSummary,RoundingNote,ScheduleTable,ErrorBoundary}.tsx, theme.css, app.css), src/main.tsx, eslint.config.js. Domain layer was reviewed at G4.1. Read decision-log D-46 to D-49.

IMPORTANT environment note: a stale `vite preview` on port 4173 can be silently reused by Playwright locally; ALWAYS run Playwright with `CI=1` (forces a fresh build) — e.g. `CI=1 npx playwright test e2e/s01-calculate.spec.ts e2e/s02-validation.spec.ts e2e/s03-totals.spec.ts e2e/s04-stale.spec.ts e2e/s09-reset.spec.ts`. Before you finish, make sure nothing of yours is left listening on 4173.

Step 1 (group-scoped): run those five specs in all three browsers with CI=1, plus `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`, `npx vitest run`. Expected per the developer: 46/48 per browser, with AC-4.4 and AC-9.2 failing only because the Theme select (group 4) and saved calculations (group 5) don't exist yet (D-47). Verify that claim — confirm the failure point in each is the missing Theme control, not something else.
Step 2: freeze check per spec §12.4 against tag g3-tests-approved. Exactly two owner-approved changes are expected (D-46: e2e/s09-reset.spec.ts, two strings; D-48: e2e/fixtures.ts summary() helper). Flag anything else.
Step 3: spec conformance for this group — §3.2 transitions (edit/unit/invalid/valid/reset; idle vs stale), §4 inputs (type=text, inputmode, autocomplete), §7 copy character-for-character (all of copy.ts, even keys not yet rendered), §8.1 order and button types, §8.2 schedule markup, §8.3 errors/focus/aria-live, §8.3.1 DOM contract, §10 ErrorBoundary, CLAUDE.md hard rules (no JS number for money in ui, no hard-coded user-visible strings outside copy.ts).
Step 4: exploratory testing in the real app (Playwright scripts in e2e/review/, run with CI=1): pasted text with newlines/tabs, a 10,000-character amount, rapid double Calculate, Enter held/repeated, Calculate then edit then Reset sequences, Reset while focus is in the unit select, the browser back button, 200% zoom at 360 px wide, keyboard-only entry of L-A, editing a value back to its original text (must stay stale), changing currency while stale. Turn each REAL defect into a failing `[REVIEW-n]` test; do not leave assertion-free probes behind (delete probe files that found nothing).
Step 5: code quality (Minor unless it risks a wrong result or an a11y failure).

End with `BLOCKING FINDINGS: <count>`. Do not edit src/ or any frozen test.

71-### D-01 Three roles
72-- **Proposal:** R-1 Prospective Borrower (decides whether to borrow), R-2 Loan Advisor (quotes customers professionally: speed, precision, recall, privacy), R-3 Existing Borrower (tracks a loan already running).
73-- **Why:** Their needs differ, and those differences explain why history, delete, keyboard speed and the schedule exist. One "user" role could not justify those stories.
74-- **Alternative:** Two roles (drop R-3). This saves no build work, because the schedule is needed anyway, but it weakens the product story.
75-
76-### D-02 Input bounds
77-- **Proposal:** Loan amount 1,000 to 1,000,000,000 (up to 2 dp); rate 0 to 50% (up to 2 dp); tenure 1 to 40 years or 1 to 480 months (whole numbers).
--
350:- **Decision (owner, 2026-10-18), superseded in part by D-48:** the "Summary figures" row was wrong. Playwright, following WAI-ARIA, never gives the `definition` (or `term`) role an accessible name, so `getByRole('definition', { name: 'Monthly payment' })` can match nothing, whatever the markup. The markup stays the same; tests locate the figures with `getByLabel` instead (D-48). This was the developer's error in writing D-43.
351-
352-### D-44 Test-designer interpretations (Proposed, owner to review at G3)
353-These readings were made while writing the tests. They become binding when the tests freeze.
354-1. **AC-8.1:** "the schedule area" is exactly one tab stop, the `role="region"` wrapper. Table cells are not focusable.
355-2. **AC-8.5:** "never moves focus to anything on the page behind the dialog" is checked as: after every Tab or Shift+Tab, the active element is inside the open dialog, or is `body`/`document` (focus has left to the browser UI, which a test can't observe).
356-3. **AC-5.2:** "every input, select and button" includes the disabled **Clear all** and every Restore/Delete button, measured after one calculation.
357-4. **AC-5.5:** "side by side" at 1280 px means the results text sits to the right of the Loan amount input and overlaps the form vertically. "Stacked" at 768 px and 360 px means the results start below the **Calculate** button.
358-5. **AC-11.2:** each history `<li>` shows its three lines as separate lines of `innerText`, in order (line1, line2, line3). The Restore/Delete labels are ignored.
359-6. **AC-11.5, third case:** "switch to USD and calculate L-A again" means pressing Calculate without editing the inputs.
360-7. **AC-3.6:** "plus all reference loans" means the seven reference loans plus both §5.3 regression loans, checked against invariants 1 to 7.
361-8. **AC-10.8:** the timing ends when 481 `<tr>` elements (header plus 480 rows) are in the table, measured with a `MutationObserver` from the Calculate click.
362-9. **§4.1 `normaliseAmount`:** returns the trimmed text unchanged when the grouping is invalid. With valid grouping it removes only the commas, without stripping zeros (`'1,000.50'` gives `'1000.50'`, `'1,000.'` gives `'1000.'`).
--
377:### D-46 Post-G3 test fix: AC-9.2 expected currency (owner-approved change to a frozen test)
378-- **Found by:** Claude Code, while reading the group 2 specs before writing any UI code. The developer stopped and raised it, per CLAUDE.md.
379-- **Defect:** in `e2e/s09-reset.spec.ts`, `[AC-9.2]` switches to USD, *then* calculates L-A and L-B, but expects the entries to read `Rs 2,500,000.00 …` and `Rs 1,000,000.00 …`. Under spec §9.2 and AC-7.5, entries keep the currency they were calculated in, so a correct app shows `$2,500,000.00 at 18% for 5 years` and `$1,000,000.00 at 12% for 1 year`. The AC is right; the test's expected strings are wrong.
380-- **Decision (owner, 2026-10-18):** Change only those two expected strings to the `$` form; the setup stays as it is. The `test-designer` (not the developer) makes the edit, and the owner sees the diff. The reviewer's freeze check will show this change after `g3-tests-approved`; this entry is its authorisation.
381-- **Rejected alternative:** calculate in PKR first, then switch to USD.
382-
383:### D-48 Post-G3 fix: summary figures located with `getByLabel` (owner-approved change to a frozen test)
384-- **Found by:** Claude Code in group 2. The first run with real UI rendered the right figures (Rs 88,848.79 / Rs 66,185.45 / Rs 1,066,185.45), but no named `definition` existed.
385-- **Evidence:** Playwright's name computation lists `definition` and `term` among the roles that prohibit naming. A probe page with `<dt id>` / `<dd aria-labelledby>` returned 0 matches for `getByRole('definition', { name })`, and exactly 1 (the `<dd>`) for `getByLabel(name, { exact: true })`, in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit alike. Unnamed `getByRole('definition')` counts still work, so "no results shown" checks are unaffected.
386-- **Decision (owner, 2026-10-18):** In `e2e/fixtures.ts`, the `summary()` helper changes from `getByRole('definition', { name, exact: true })` to `getByLabel(name, { exact: true })`. Spec §8.3.1 is updated to match. The `test-designer` makes the test edit, and the owner sees the diff. No assertion on the figures changes.
387-- **Rejected alternative:** render each figure as `<output>` (`status` role, nameable). That makes three live regions announcing every recalculation, and it's a larger change.
388-
389:### D-49 Group 2 implementation choices (Proposed, owner to review at G4.2)
390-1. **Currency select:** built in group 2 (in memory only), because AC-1.12 checks it's present. Persistence comes with S-7 in group 4.
391-2. **Idle and stale texts** sit in an `aria-live="polite"` container, so screen-reader users hear "Your inputs have changed…" (the G1 batch asked for this choice to be stated).
392-3. **ESLint `jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-tabindex`:** allows `tabIndex` on `role="region"`, because spec §8.2 requires the scrollable schedule region to be focusable (AC-8.4).
393-4. **Schedule wrapper:** the heading and table sit in a `<div>`, not a `<section>`, so only one element has the region name "Repayment schedule". Two would break `getByRole('region', …)`.
394-5. **Inputs:** each input has its own `useRef`; the React Hooks rule forbids reading a ref from an object during render.
395-6. **Styling:** basic light-theme CSS and layout now. Dark tokens come with S-6, and breakpoints and tap targets are refined with S-5.
396-7. **Local E2E runs use `CI=1`.** A leftover `vite preview` on port 4173 served an old build, and `reuseExistingServer: !process.env.CI` made Playwright reuse it, which can give false results either way. `CI=1` forces a fresh build. A permanent fix needs a change to the frozen `playwright.config.ts` (`reuseExistingServer: false`), and that is for the owner to decide.

### 3.2 Application state (reducer)

```
inputs:   { amount: string, rate: string, tenure: string, unit: 'years' | 'months' }   // raw text as typed
errors:   Partial<Record<'amount' | 'rate' | 'tenure', ErrorCode>>
results:  { status: 'idle' }
        | { status: 'shown', loan: CalculatedLoan }
        | { status: 'stale' }
settings: { currency: 'PKR' | 'USD', theme: 'system' | 'light' | 'dark' }
history:  { available: boolean, entries: HistoryEntry[] }
```

Transitions:

| Event | Effect |
|---|---|
| Edit any input or change unit | Update `inputs`. Clear **only that field's** error (changing the unit clears the tenure error). If `results.status === 'shown'`, set it to `stale`; `idle` stays `idle`. Editing a value back to its original text still leaves results `stale`. |
| Calculate with any invalid field | Set all field errors, set `results` to `idle` (removes old results), focus the first invalid field in order amount → rate → tenure. |
| Calculate with all fields valid | Clear errors, compute, set `results` to `shown`, add a history entry (§9.3). |
| Reset | Empty inputs, unit = `years`, clear errors, set `results` to `idle`, focus **Loan amount**. Settings and history are untouched. |
| Change currency or theme | Update settings and persist. Results status is unchanged. |
| Restore entry | Set inputs from the entry (canonical strings, §9.2), clear **all** field errors, and set the currency from the entry and **persist** it like any currency change. Recompute (do not trust stored figures) and set `results` to `shown`. No new history entry. (D-14) |

## 4. Input parsing and validation

Inputs are `<input type="text">`, **not** `type="number"`. `type="number"` behaves differently across browsers: Firefox accepts letters, `value` becomes `""` for invalid text so errors can't be diagnosed, and the mouse wheel changes values. Add `inputmode` per AC-5.4 and `autocomplete="off"`.

### 4.1 Normalisation (before validation)

| Field | Steps |
|---|---|
| Loan amount | Trim whitespace. If the value contains `,`, remove the commas **only if** the part before any `.` (after an optional leading `-`) matches western grouping `^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})+$` or lakh grouping `^\d{1,2}(,\d{2})*,\d{3}$`, and no `,` appears after the `.`. Otherwise leave the commas in, so the value fails the number pattern with `AMOUNT_NAN` (D-26). Accepts `1,000,000`, `10,00,000`, `1,00,000` and `1,000.50`; rejects `1,,000`, `1000,50`, `1,5`, `,1000` and `10,0000`. |
| Interest rate | Trim, remove **one** trailing `%`, trim again. |
| Loan tenure | Trim. |

## 8. UI behaviour

### 8.1 Layout (DOM order = visual order = tab order)

1. **Header:** title, tagline, **Theme** select (right-aligned on wide screens).
2. **Form card:** **Currency** select and its note, **Loan amount**, **Annual interest rate**, **Loan tenure** + **Tenure unit**, then **Calculate** (primary, `type="submit"`) and **Reset** (secondary, `type="button"`). It is a `<form noValidate>`, so Enter submits. The dialog buttons are also `type="button"`.
3. **Results card:** idle text (shown whenever `results` is `idle`, including next to field errors; D-27), or the stale message, or the summary (Monthly payment shown prominently, Total interest, Total amount payable), the rounding note when applicable, and the **Repayment schedule**.
4. **Saved calculations card:** heading (`tabindex="-1"` so focus can move there), the list or the empty/unavailable text, and **Clear all**.

Breakpoints: **≥ 769 px**: the form and results cards side by side (form roughly 40%, results roughly 60%) with Saved calculations full-width below; max content width 1200 px. **≤ 768 px**: a single column in DOM order. Never allow horizontal page scroll at any width ≥ 360 px. Long amounts wrap (`overflow-wrap: anywhere`) rather than overflow.

### 8.2 Schedule table

A semantic `<table>` with `<thead>` and `<th scope="col">`, inside a wrapper with `role="region"`, `aria-label` = `schedule.title`, `tabindex="0"`, `overflow: auto` and `max-height: min(60vh, 480px)`. The `<table>` has `aria-labelledby` pointing at the visible `schedule.title` heading, so tests can find both `getByRole('region', { name: 'Repayment schedule' })` and `getByRole('table', { name: 'Repayment schedule' })`. The header row is sticky. Number cells are right-aligned with `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`. On narrow screens the wrapper scrolls horizontally if needed; the page does not.

### 8.3 Errors and focus

- Each error renders in an element with an id. The input gets `aria-invalid="true"` and `aria-describedby` pointing to it, and the error text sits in an `aria-live="polite"` container.
- On a failed Calculate, focus moves to the first invalid field. On Reset, focus moves to **Loan amount**. On Delete, focus moves per AC-12.1. On Restore, focus stays on the Restore button.
- **Confirm dialog:** native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`. Focus targets are set **explicitly in code**, not with React's `autoFocus` (which fires at mount, not at `showModal()`) and not left to the browser's return-focus (macOS Safari and Firefox don't focus buttons on click). After `showModal()`, focus **Cancel**. **Cancel** or Escape (the `cancel` event) closes it without action and focuses **Clear all**. **Clear** clears the history and focuses the **Saved calculations** heading, because **Clear all** is now disabled (D-30). `aria-labelledby` points to the `dialog.clear.text` element and `aria-describedby` to `dialog.clear.hint`. **No JS focus trap** (D-20): Tab may leave the dialog to the browser's own UI, but must never reach page content behind the dialog (AC-8.5).

### 8.3.1 Test-facing DOM contract (D-43; frozen with the tests at G3)

Tests locate elements only by role and accessible name. The app must provide:

| What | Markup | How tests find it |
|---|---|---|
| Title | `<h1>` = `app.title` | `getByRole('heading', { level: 1 })` |
| Inputs and selects | `<label>` text from §7 | `getByLabel('Loan amount (Rs)')`, `getByLabel('Annual interest rate (%)')`, `getByLabel('Loan tenure')`, `getByLabel('Tenure unit')`, `getByLabel('Currency')`, `getByLabel('Theme')` |
| Field errors | Error element linked with `aria-describedby` | `expect(input).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Enter a loan amount.')` and `toHaveAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true')` |
| Summary figures | `<dl>`; each `<dd>` has `aria-labelledby` pointing at its `<dt>` (`summary.monthly`, `summary.interest`, `summary.total`) | `getByLabel('Monthly payment', { exact: true })` has text `Rs 88,848.79`. Playwright never names the `definition` role, so `getByRole('definition', { name })` cannot work (D-48). |
| Idle, stale and rounding texts | Plain text in the results card | `getByText(...)` with the exact §7 string |
| Schedule | `<h2>` = `schedule.title`; region and table named by it (§8.2); `<th scope="col">` per §7 | `getByRole('table', { name: 'Repayment schedule' })`, `getByRole('row')`, `getByRole('columnheader')`, `getByRole('cell')` |
| Saved calculations | `<h2 tabindex="-1">` = `history.title`; `<ul aria-labelledby>` that heading; one `<li>` per entry holding three lines (§7 line1, line2, line3) | `getByRole('list', { name: 'Saved calculations' })`, `getByRole('listitem')` |
| Entry buttons | Accessible names per §7 (D-29) | `getByRole('button', { name: 'Restore Rs 2,500,000.00 at 18% for 5 years, saved …' })` |
| Dialog | `<dialog>` named by `dialog.clear.text` | `getByRole('dialog', { name: "Clear all saved calculations? This can't be undone." })` |
| Theme | `data-theme` on `<html>` | `document.documentElement.dataset.theme` |
| Removal failure | Text in the Saved calculations card | `getByText(...)` with `history.removeFailed` |

## 10. Error handling

- No error may reach the user as a blank screen. Wrap `<App>` in an `ErrorBoundary` that renders the `fatal` message.
- The domain layer returns typed results for invalid input and never throws on user input.
- E2E tests attach `page.on('pageerror')` and `page.on('console', type === 'error')` listeners **globally** (via a fixture) and fail if either fires (AC-2.16).

G4.2 review (S-1, S-2, S-3, S-4, S-9): no Blocker or Major defect found. I appended a dated G4.2 section to C:\Users\arslan.NINEALPHA\muhammad-arslan-calculator\docs\process\review-findings.md with Edit; the G4.1 section is intact.

**Step 1, gate**
- The five specs ran with `CI=1` in chromium, firefox and webkit. Result: `6 failed, 138 passed`, so 46 of 48 per browser, as you said. The failures are exactly AC-4.4 and AC-9.2 in each browser.
- `npm run lint` exit 0, `npm run typecheck` exit 0, `format:check` clean, `npx vitest run` 7 files and 294 tests passed.
- AC-9.2 is confirmed as the missing Theme control. The webkit output shows `TimeoutError ... waiting for getByLabel('Theme', { exact: true })` on the `themeSel(...).selectOption` line. The currency step before it passed, and the failure comes before any saved-calculation step.
- AC-4.4 is confirmed less directly. Its call-log scrolled out of my captured output, so I'm relying on the test body in `e2e/s04-stale.spec.ts` lines 75-89 plus the same missing-Theme pattern. The currency part of that test passes in the app, and the only other control it uses is `themeSel`.
- My `EXIT 0` came from `tail`, not Playwright. The runner itself reported the 6 failures.

**Step 2, freeze check**
- Exactly two changes after `g3-tests-approved`, both authorised: 749144e (D-46, two strings in `e2e/s09-reset.spec.ts`) and 5751988 (D-48, `summary()` in `e2e/fixtures.ts`).
- No skip, only, fixme, `test.fail`, deleted test or weakened assertion.

**Step 3, conformance**
- Everything checked matched the spec:
  - §3.2 transitions: edit, unit, invalid, calculated, reset and currency, including edit-back-stays-stale.
  - §4 inputs.
  - §7 copy: all plain strings checked programmatically, templated ones by reading.
  - §8.1 order and button types.
  - §8.2 schedule markup.
  - §8.3 and §8.3.1 errors, focus and DOM contract.
  - The ErrorBoundary code (§10).
- No number touches money in `src/ui`. There are no hard-coded user-visible strings outside `copy.ts`, and no layer-boundary violations.

**Step 4, exploratory testing**
- Everything behaved correctly in all three browsers. I deleted the probe specs because they found nothing, so there are no `[REVIEW-n]` tests and `e2e/review/` is empty.
- Cases tried:
  - 10,000-character amount.
  - Tabs and padding around values.
  - Double click plus 10 repeated Enter presses.
  - Calculate, edit, Reset with focus in the unit select.
  - Editing back to the original text, and changing currency while stale.
  - Keyboard-only entry of L-A.
  - Failed Calculate over old results.
  - Unicode and full-width digits, `1,,000`, `1e6`, `+1000000`, and rates `00012`, `.5`, `5.`, `-0`.
  - 360 px and 180 px (200% zoom) layouts, with a screenshot reviewed.
  - Reload and back navigation after choosing Months, to check the selects stay in sync with app state.

**Step 5, Minor findings**
- M-1: without `CI=1` a stale `vite preview` on 4173 can be reused; the owner needs to decide on `playwright.config.ts` (D-49.7).
- M-2: the currency note is not linked to the Currency select with `aria-describedby`.
- M-3: `ErrorBoundary` has no test or logging, and only covers render errors.
- M-4: the `AppContext` value is not memoised, `main.tsx` fails silently if `#root` is missing, and there are `as Unit` and `as Currency` casts.
- M-5: summary figures wrap inconsistently at 360 px, and each field always reserves an empty error line.
- M-6: the sticky `th` background may clash with dark tokens once S-6 lands.

Nothing of mine is listening on port 4173 (only TIME_WAIT sockets remain), and I did not edit `src/` or any frozen test.
